limitations_and_boundaries: Survival analysis in HNSCC and EAC used 'snapshot' imaging of representative stromal regions, while CRC used automated whole-TMA imaging; methods were correlated but not identical.
Multivariate analysis showed fiber length was an independent prognostic factor in HNSCC and CRC but not in EAC.
Xenograft model used a single HNSCC cell line (5PT) and one fibroblast line (HFFF2); generalizability to other tumor types and fibroblast sources is unknown.
Proteomic heterogeneity analysis was performed on a limited number of CAF lines (CAF1807, CAF506) and NOFs.
The study does not establish a causal mechanism linking collagen fiber elongation to poor survival, only correlation.
Collagen fiber alignment was not a significant prognostic factor in HNSCC and EAC, and only approached significance in CRC.
